sahneler.metin: On approach to Nagoya, an Airbus pitched up steeply and stalled.
It crashed beside the runway, and two hundred sixty four people died.
The first officer had accidentally triggered go-around mode.
He pushed the nose down to keep landing.
The autopilot kept trimming the nose up.
The aircraft ended up badly out of trim.
When it pitched up, it stalled.
Airbus changed the autopilot so pilot inputs override it.

aciklama:
China Airlines 140 stalled and crashed on approach to Nagoya. The cause: pilot pushing the nose down while the autopilot trimmed nose up, ending in a stall.
